propositions: Pass 3 of code-review ignores project-level routing overrides (threshold, blocking, nit-suppression) because resolvers are called without the repository-effective routing map
registry.threshold_for and registry.nit_suppressed_criteria accept optional routing_map parameters but code_review_decide calls them with defaults, reading only packaged routing
Thread registry.effective_routing(ctx.repo_root) into Pass-3 by binding it via functools.partial to threshold_for and passing it to nit_suppressed_criteria
Project routing overrides must govern Pass-3 disposition for project findings, verified against synthetic repo fixtures with lower block thresholds and nit-suppression rules
Pass-3 dispositions must remain byte-identical when no overlay is present, preserving parity with the packaged-default code path
